THAT.example: It was the lack of consultation that angered local residents.
THAT.exampleZh: It was X that... 是強調句。

WHICH.exampleZh: 逗號後的補充說明（非限定子句）只能用 which，不能用 that。

WAS DISCUSSING.exampleZh: 由 when 帶出的過去簡單式（walked）可知，主要子句應使用過去進行式，表示當時正在進行的動作

MOVING.example: Our manager suggested moving the weekly meeting to Thursday morning.
MOVING.exampleZh: suggest（建議）後面必須接動名詞（V-ing）作受詞，不能接不定詞。

WAS WRITING.example: I was writing an email to my colleague when my computer suddenly shut down.
WAS WRITING.exampleZh: 描述過去某個時間點正在發生的事（寫信），被另一個突發動作（關機）打斷，使用過去進行式

TO ANSWER.meaning: 停下原本的動作，轉而去做另一件事
TO ANSWER.example: A: Did you manage to finish the report? B: No, I stopped to answer a phone call, and then it was time to leave.
TO ANSWER.exampleZh: stop to V 表示「停下原本的動作，轉而去做另一件事」。

WERE HIKING.example: While they were hiking through the dense forest, they discovered a rare species of bird.
WERE HIKING.exampleZh: While 引導的子句通常使用進行式，表示在過去一段持續的時間內（徒步旅行中）發生了另一件事（發現鳥類）

TO WORK.example: Many employees plan to work from home at least twice a week.
TO WORK.exampleZh: plan（計畫）後面必須接不定詞（to V）當作受詞。

ITS SCHEDULE HAS BEEN CHANGED.example: 【短文】Notice: The annual tech conference, which usually takes place in June, has been delayed to August. The venue will remain the same. Q: What is true about the tech conference?
ITS SCHEDULE HAS BEEN CHANGED.exampleZh: 短文中提到會議從六月延遲到八月（delayed to August），地點維持不變（remain the same），故選 D

WERE TESTING.example: At 8 PM last night, the technicians were testing the new artificial intelligence system.
WERE TESTING.exampleZh: 句子明確點出過去的特定時間（At 8 PM last night），此時應使用過去進行式表示當時正在進行的動作

TO LOCK.example: I completely forgot to lock the office door when I left yesterday evening.
TO LOCK.exampleZh: forget to V 表示「忘記去做某事（事情還沒做）」。

WERE YOU DOING.example: A: What were you doing when the earthquake hit? B: I was reading a book in the living room.
WERE YOU DOING.exampleZh: 根據回答「I was reading...」以及 when 帶出的過去時間，問句需用過去進行式

HEARING.example: I look forward to hearing from you.
HEARING.exampleZh: look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後面接 V-ing。

JANES MENTOR.example:
【短文】Subject: Welcome! 
Dear Jane,

Q: Who is Mr. Davis?
JANES MENTOR.exampleZh: 信中寫道「The mentor who will guide you... is Mr. Davis」，表示 Mr. Davis 是 Jane 的導師

WERE DISCUSSING.example: They were discussing the budget for next year when the power went out.

CLOSING.example: Would you mind closing the window? It's getting a bit cold in here.

WHOSE.example: A: whose bag is this on the classroom chair? B: It belongs to our teacher, Mr. Chen.

WAS PREPARING.meaning: 過去同時正在發生的兩個動作
WAS PREPARING.example: While the chef was preparing the ingredients, the waiters were setting up the tables.

WATCHING.example: I remember watching this movie before; the ending is very surprising.
WATCHING.exampleZh: remember V-ing 表示「記得曾經做過某事」。

WERE UPGRADING.example: While the engineers were upgrading the software, they found a critical bug in the system.
WERE UPGRADING.exampleZh: While 引導的過去時間子句，表示當時正在進行升級（upgrading）的動作

LEAKING.example: He denied leaking the confidential documents to the press.

THE CONTRACT.example: 【短文】Email: Hi Sarah, please remember to bring the contract that we printed yesterday. We will need it for the client meeting at 2 PM. Q: What does Sarah need to bring?

WERE WAITING.exampleZh: 描述在過去某個時間點正在進行的動作（等公車），被下雨這件事打斷

WERE OPERATING.example: While the astronauts were operating the spacecraft, they lost connection with Earth.

EATING.example: She couldn't resist eating a piece of chocolate cake after a long day at work.

TO COMPLETE.example: They aim to complete the construction of the new laboratory by next spring.

WERE CLEANING.example: While the volunteers were cleaning the beach, they collected fifty bags of trash.

WAS.example: The new software was installed on all office computers yesterday afternoon.

WAS TAKING.example:
A: Why didn't you answer my call? 
B: I was taking a shower when the phone rang.
WAS TAKING.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：回答過去某個特定時間點正在進行的動作，使用過去進行式 (was taking)

USING.example:
A: How did you fix the error? 
B: I simply stopped using the faulty code.
USING.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：stop V-ing 表示「停止做某事」，stop to V 則是「停下來去做另一件事」。

WERE MIXING.meaning: 我們正在混合化學物質
WERE MIXING.example:
A: What happened at the lab?

WERE MIXING.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：玻璃破裂 (broke) 是過去發生的瞬間，當時「我們正在混合化學物質」，故用過去進行式 were mixing

SPENDING.example:
A: Are you going to the party? 
B: No, I can't justify spending money on expensive tickets right now.
SPENDING.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：justify (證明...是合理的) 後方接動詞時，通常搭配動名詞 (V-ing)，表示無法為花費找理由。

WAS INTERVIEWING.example: The journalist was interviewing the celebrity when the celebrity suddenly got angry.
WAS INTERVIEWING.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：突然生氣 (got angry) 為過去式突發事件，前面正在進行的採訪動作需用過去進行式

TO SECURE.example: Many startup founders struggle to secure funding during their first year of business.
TO SECURE.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：struggle to V 表示「努力/掙扎著去做某事」，需接不定詞。

WERE PREPARING.example: While the locals were preparing the festival, a sudden thunderstorm ruined the decorations.
WERE PREPARING.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：背景動作發生在過去 (ruined 為過去式)，表示當地人當時正在準備，因此用過去進行式 were preparing

WAS WATCHING.example:

WAS WATCHING.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：問句使用了過去進行式詢問過去特定時間正在做什麼，回答也應一致使用過去進行式
